bases.cm1-assignment: assigned before the namelist is read: src/cm1.F's start-up block for the param groups (the read of param0 is at src/cm1.F:480), init_module_wrf_error for logging
bases.declaration-initializer: the initializer on the module variable's declaration; for the NSSL groups, nssl_2mom_init may still adjust some of them before its own read
bases.static-zero: r21.1 sets no value before the read; the module variable is static storage, which gfortran and ifort zero-fill, so an unset key reads 0, 0.0, .false. or blanks. The Fortran standard leaves it undefined.

required_groups.why: cm1.F reads these groups with no end= branch, so a file without one stops CM1 before param.F runs
